subject: SagePoint pilot — post-demo technical next steps and POC scope
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@sagepoint.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@sagepoint.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Apr 2029 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: SagePoint pilot — post-demo technical next steps and POC scope

Hi Liam/Priya — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before the technical kickoff: 

1) High-level POC goal (what success looks like)
- Ingest SagePoint’s query logs and surface intent-categorized responses with >= 85% relevance on our initial eval set.
- End-to-end latency (user visible) <= 350ms P95 for single-turn queries in the pilot environment.
- Token cost target: average <= $0.0035/token for the evaluation workload.

2) Technical scope we discussed
- SDK integration for batch test runs (Python + Node sample code).
- Streaming route for interactive product demos (websocket/HTTP chunking) with tool-calling stubs for a simple enrichment step (lookup -> augment -> respond).
- KV-cache prefixing for common user prompts to show cost/latency gains.

3) Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): Exchange credentials and sandbox access; share success_criteria doc and SDK route map. (Action: Olga)
- Week 1: Engineering spike — SagePoint runs basic SDK sample against a small dataset; Redwood provides a preconfigured deployment. (Action: Liam/Priya + Ben)
- Week 2: Integration demo and first metric review (relevance, latency, cost). Decide whether to expand scope. (Action: joint)

4) Owners and contacts
- Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com) — SDK + runtime routing
- Redwood product/ops: Olga Petrov (olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com) — POC coordination, success criteria
- SagePoint technical lead: Liam Turner (liam.turner@sagepoint.ai) — dataset & access

5) Items I’m attaching to this thread:
- sagepoint_success_criteria.pdf (baseline metrics + small eval prompt set)
- sdk_route_map.md (routes we’ll exercise: /v1/generate, /v1/stream, /v1/embeddings)
- redwood_rsa_pubkey.txt (for initial signed webhook verification)

Ask: can you confirm you can provide a 5–10k example query log export (anonymized) by EOD Friday? That will let us seed the initial relevance eval.

If that works I’ll schedule the Week 1 spike call and open the sandbox project in our Console.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

Subject: Re: SagePoint pilot — post-demo technical next steps and POC scope

Thanks for the clear recap, Olga — a few clarifications from engineering and a short checklist for the Week 1 spike: 

Quick clarifications:
- For streaming we’ll use our /v1/stream route with chunked JSON events; the client should implement incremental decoding. We’ll include a small JS sample that shows tool-calling hooks (a JSON "tools" array with call and return).
- On the runtime side we’ll provision a single m40x-like capacity pool for the pilot; if the workload pushes beyond 12 concurrent streams we can scale to the next tranche automatically.

Week 1 spike checklist (Ben -> action items we’ll own):
- Provide Docker-based sandbox image + API key for testing (will share by EOD tomorrow).
- Provide sample SDK snippets for Python/Node including streaming and a tool-calling example (payload + expected shape).
- Help instrument a small eval harness that runs 5k anonymized queries through both non-streaming and streaming to capture latency/cost deltas.

Notes for SagePoint engineering (Liam/Priya):
- Please confirm the export format for the query logs (CSV with columns: qid, user_text, timestamp, session_id) or provide a small sample JSONL. If JSONL, include session_id so we can test KV caching behavior.
- If you plan to call our tool-calling extension for lookups, please send a short spec of the lookup API (endpoint, auth, typical response size).

I’ll also add a short runbook for fallback behavior — if the primary model variant is saturated the traffic will automatically route to a cheaper quantized variant with the same API shape (we’ll document the expected delta in latency/quality for transparency).

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Olga — this looks great and aligns with our expectations. Quick responses inline: 

- Query log export: we can provide a 7k row anonymized CSV (qid,user_text,timestamp,session_id) by Friday EOD. Will attach a 50-row sample in the follow-up.
- Tool-calling: we have an internal lookup service (https://internal.sagepoint.ai/lookup) that requires token auth; average response payload is ~800 bytes. We can provide a key scoped to the pilot environment.
- Success criteria: 85% initial relevance target is reasonable. On latency, 350ms P95 is tight for some geo-distributed sessions — can we confirm that the P95 target is measured from our sandbox frontend to the Redwood sandbox endpoint? If so we’ll run a synthetic once we have the sandbox URL.

Next steps we agreed to on our side:
- Provide logs + sample dataset (Liam) by Friday
- Stand up a pair of engineers for the Week 1 spike (Priya and Anil)

We’d also like to confirm data retention during the pilot and how long logs will be available in Redwood for evaluation (we discussed 30 days, correct?).

Thanks,
Liam Turner
Head of ML Engineering | SagePoint Analytics
liam.turner@sagepoint.ai

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmations, Liam. A couple of follow-ups and final operational notes before I open the sandbox project: 

1) Latency measurement: we’ll measure P95 from the Redwood sandbox public endpoint back to your frontend — please run the synthetic from the same location you’ll use for demos. We’ll document measurement methodology in the runbook.

2) Data retention: Pilot artifacts and logs will be retained for 30 days in the sandbox by default. If you need longer retention we can enable a 90-day policy for the pilot (requires a short procurement form).

3) Security/access checklist (please provide):
- An API key for your lookup service (scoped to internal.sagepoint.ai) and endpoint swagger/contract.
- Sample query export (CSV or JSONL) — 5k–7k rows preferably with session_id.
- IP ranges for any demo origin hosts you expect us to whitelist.

4) Next meeting: I scheduled a 60-minute Week 1 spike kickoff on Monday, Apr 15 at 10:00 AM PT — invite is in your calendar. Agenda: sandbox access, run the SDK sample, run one streaming session, capture first metrics.

5) Owners recap (for clarity):
- Redwood (SDK + runtime): Ben Carter
- Redwood (POC coordination + success criteria): Olga Petrov
- Redwood (fallback/runbook & billing guardrails): Karthik Iyer
- SagePoint (dataset + lookup API): Liam Turner, Priya Rao

I’ve uploaded the success criteria doc and SDK route guide to the shared Drive link (see thread metadata). If all looks good I’ll create the sandbox project and post the API key internally (will paste to this thread when ready).

Cheers,
Olga
